message.content:
{
  "summary": "The investigation focuses on an instrument-air interruption at RHOB during boundary preparation for WO-527. Evidence confirms work was in progress but not yet released (signature pending). The cause of the air loss is unknown; it could be upstream, downstream, or a temporary configuration issue.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "statement": "At approximately 10:00 on May 20, an instrument-air low indication occurred at RHOB service station (header H-R) while Utilities crew U-A/U-B were preparing the maintenance boundary for WO-527.",
      "type": "finding",
      "status": "verified","sourceIds":["incident-description","36f83919-8b7a-4ec0-a789-5d3e24cdaf6f"],"testNeeded":"none"}
    ],
  "questions":[
    {
      "intent": "Determine if the air interruption was caused by a physical valve state change (open/closed) during boundary preparation or an upstream/downstream failure.",
      "text": "What specific valves were open, closed, or in transition at RHOB service station and North gallery between 09:48 and 10:07?",
      "rationale":"The directory lists M-101/M-102 as main-route valves but does not record their state. Knowing which valve(s) were manipulated explains the loss of pressure at H-R.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Field observation log, field photograph, or control-system history showing valve positions and timestamps.","Interview with U-A/U-B regarding specific actions taken on M-101/M-102."],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Verify whether an approved temporary instruction was physically attached to the work package despite the blank field on the cover copy.",
      "text": "Was a physical, issued temporary instruction document or attachment present in the WO-527 folder at the time of interruption?",
      "rationale":"The cover sheet shows a blank field for 'Temporary instruction', but conventions state an empty form records no value and does not prove absence. A missing approved temp instruction could explain why boundary preparation proceeded without full engineering disposition.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Physical inspection or digital scan of the WO-527 folder contents.","Witness testimony from U-A/U-B regarding what documents were in their possession."],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Determine if the air interruption originated upstream (North gallery), within distribution, or at RHOB receiving equipment.",
      "text": "Did indication P-U show a low-pressure condition simultaneously with or before the alarm at H-R?",
      "rationale":"If P-U was normal while H-R dropped, the failure is likely downstream of P-U. If both were abnormal, the source may be upstream (air header).",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Historical pressure trace for P-U and H-R.","Control-system alarm history."],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Confirm whether the interruption duration was sufficient to cause a process upset or if it was momentary.",
      "text": "What were the exact pressure values and timestamps for P-U, H-R, and any intermediate points between 09:48 and 10:20?",
      "rationale":"Understanding severity helps assess risk. A brief dip might be a transient valve closure; sustained loss suggests failure.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Pressure recorder data.","Alarm export logs."],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Identify if any scope change or discovery occurred that was not documented in the work package before 10:00.",
      "text": "Did U-A/U-B discover a condition (e.g., stuck valve, leak) requiring immediate action between collecting the folder and the alarm?",
      "rationale":"Scope drift during preparation is common. If they opened/closed valves to fix something not in WO-527, that explains the loss.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Field notes or verbal report from U-A/U-B.","Photographs of work area."],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Determine if M-A (Maintenance receiver) was present and whether boundary acceptance had occurred physically.",
      "text": "Was M-A at the field location when the alarm sounded, and did they sign off on any temporary configuration?",
      "rationale":"If M-A was absent or refused to accept a non-normal state without proper documentation, that could explain why work proceeded unsafely.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Attendance log for shift.","Interview with M-A."],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Check if any contractor or other crew was working in the same area that could have caused interference.",
      "text": "Were there simultaneous operations (SIMOPS) involving contractors or other crews near H-R between 09:35 and 10:20?",
      "rationale":"External work can cause valve closures, line openings, or equipment failures not captured in the Utilities crew's scope.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Contractor logs.","SIMOPS permit records."],
      "priority": "low",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]},
    {
      "intent": "Verify if any change control (ECP revision) was pending or incomplete that could have affected the system.",
      "text": "Was ECP-1SC-04 Rev3 fully issued and distributed to field personnel before 09:48, or were draft changes in effect?",
      "rationale":"Section 3.6 of IA-D03 requires an approved temp instruction if a change affects the boundary. Drafts alone are insufficient.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Change control system records.","Distribution logs for ECP-1SC-04 Rev3."],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[]}],
  "handoffs":[],
  "decision": {
    "summary":"The investigation has identified the event (air loss during boundary prep) and key unknowns: valve states, presence of temporary instruction, source location of failure, and exact duration. The next step is to gather field evidence on these points.",
    "evidenceUsed":["incident-description","IA-S01_shift_and_notification_log.md","IA-D02_record_and_measurement_conventions.md","IA-D03_change_and_work_record_requirements.md","IA-S02_work_package_cover.md","IA-S03_assignment_and_authorization_extract.md"],
    "unknowns":[],
    "alternatives":[],"confidence":1.0}
}
